verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows three.js works with TypeScript through the @types/three definitions, which give an agent's editor typed completions and diagnostics. However, those types are not maintained by the core project: mrdoob reportedly declines to maintain them, and some signatures don't match the code, forcing @ts-ignore. The docs call TSL 'type-safe', but that refers to shader-node composition, not editor tooling. Missing for 10: an official, first-party-maintained typed API definition package, an official language server, and documented editor or agent integration for completions and navigation.
